title: When Does INT8 Actually Accelerate Host-CPU Inference? A Reproducible Audit of MobileNetV2 Conversion and Packaging
description: Versioned code, converted model artifacts, machine-readable measurements, and manuscript for a host-CPU audit of MobileNetV2 TensorFlow Lite quantization and container packaging.
